nodes.label: EM Residency Scheduling Engine (ResidentScheduler.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately almost all scheduling logic lives in one ~7,860-line file with no module boundaries, so edits should grep for '// ─── SECTION ───' markers rather than trust drifting line numbers; auth/day-off-request surfaces are deliberately kept out of it.

nodes.label: Supabase Cloud Sync (res_state, wide-open RLS)
nodes.rationale: Optional cross-device sync via a hand-rolled fetch-based PostgREST client (no @supabase/supabase-js dependency), one fixed jsonb row, last-write-wins with no merge — an accepted tradeoff for a single coordinator used sequentially, not concurrently, same posture as sibling em-scheduler app.

nodes.label: User Feedback Widget & Admin Tab
nodes.rationale: Insert-only anon-key RLS (deliberately not res_state's wide-open posture) because the feedback table is shared with sibling em-scheduler app via an app_name column; reads only via a password-gated Netlify Function using the service-role key.

nodes.label: Auth, Roles & RLS Security Model
nodes.rationale: Three roles (pending/resident/admin) with self-promotion made impossible by construction (profiles_insert_own pins pending, enforce_profile_role_change_rules blocks self-role-change); RLS is the real security boundary, UI gates are convenience only — a real gap once existed where 'pending' was only checked client-side, enabling impersonation via /requests.

nodes.label: Resident Day-Off Request Feature (residentRequests/ + RequestsTab)
nodes.rationale: Kept as a separate surface from ResidentScheduler.jsx by design — nothing under residentRequests/ imports from it, fetching its own data from the shared res_state row instead, so the ~37-hook scheduling file stays untouched by auth state.

nodes.label: Circadian Scheduling Rules (NIGHT_RULES)
nodes.rationale: Night runs must cluster 4-6 (hard cap 6); eve/day adjacency hard-blocked; ≥24h post-night rest (incl. before Grand Rounds) is deliberately a soft rule, checked in both directions because the generator's optional fill pass can place a night shift after a day shift already scheduled 1-2 days later.

nodes.label: Journal Club Rules (JC_MAX_PER_AY)
nodes.rationale: 'Worked' JC shifts derived from SHIFT_TIMING overlap rather than a hand-maintained shift-id list so PED-S/Trauma Night are automatically covered; cap counted only across Published blocks plus the live block.

nodes.label: Schedule Generator (generateSchedule / fillDayPass)
nodes.rationale: Three-pass fill (min, TRAUMA-D, optional-max) with a candidate pool recomputed fresh per slot — caching once went stale mid-day and caused double-booking, so recomputation is deliberate, not an optimization opportunity.

nodes.label: jspdf-autotable Import Interop Bug
nodes.rationale: jspdf-autotable@3.8.4's default export resolves to a CJS namespace object under esbuild/Rollup bundling, not a callable function; npm run build succeeding does NOT catch this since bundling resolves imports without executing them. Fixed via side-effect import (patches doc.autoTable on) rather than the bare function-call form.

nodes.label: Soft Rule Priority System (appSettings.rulePriority)
nodes.rationale: Chief-orderable ranking of coverageMin/seniorComposition/postNightRest decides whether the generator reaches for a rest-violating or junior candidate versus leaving a slot unfilled — default order favors filling coverage over protecting the other two rules.

nodes.label: Rule-Default Migration (LEGACY_*_DEFAULTS)
nodes.rationale: Chief-saved overrides replace defaults wholesale, so correcting a default entry can be silently masked forever by an old override equal to the previous (wrong) default; LEGACY_*_DEFAULTS snapshots pre-correction shapes so they can be auto-pruned on mount.
